record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, <FI>A Psalm<Fi> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> In the LORD<WH03068> put I my trust<WH02620><WTH8804>: how say<WH0559><WTH8799> ye to my soul<WH05315>, Flee<WH05110><WTH8798> <FI>as<Fi> a bird<WH06833> to your mountain<WH02022>?

For, lo, the wicked<WH07563> bend<WH01869><WTH8799> <FI>their<Fi> bow<WH07198>, they make ready<WH03559><WTH8790> their arrow<WH02671> upon the string<WH03499>, that they may privily<WH0652><WTH8676><WH01119> shoot<WH03384><WTH8800> at the upright<WH03477> in heart<WH03820>. <RF>privily: Heb. in darkness<Rf>
If the foundations<WH08356> be destroyed<WH02040><WTH8735>, what can the righteous<WH06662> do<WH06466><WTH8804>?<CM>

The LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> in his holy<WH06944> temple<WH01964>, the LORD'S<WH03068> throne<WH03678> <FI>is<Fi> in heaven<WH08064>: his eyes<WH05869> behold<WH02372><WTH8799>, his eyelids<WH06079> try<WH0974><WTH8799>, the children<WH01121> of men<WH0120>.
The LORD<WH03068> trieth<WH0974><WTH8799> the righteous<WH06662>: but the wicked<WH07563> and him that loveth<WH0157><WTH8802> violence<WH02555> his soul<WH05315> hateth<WH08130><WTH8804>.

Upon the wicked<WH07563> he shall rain<WH04305><WTH8686> snares<WH06341>, fire<WH0784> and brimstone<WH01614>, and an horrible<WH02152> tempest<WH07307>: <FI>this shall be<Fi> the portion<WH04521> of their cup<WH03563>. <RF>an horrible...: or, a burning tempest<Rf>
For the righteous<WH06662> LORD<WH03068> loveth<WH0157><WTH8804> righteousness<WH06666>; his countenance<WH06440> doth behold<WH02372><WTH8799> the upright<WH03477>.<CM>
